_meta.what_this_is: A set of documents each with a similarity score to the query and a metadata field (team). The query is only allowed to use documents where team==eng (a permission or scope filter). Two ways to combine the filter with the vector search. POST-FILTER retrieves the top-k by similarity first, then drops the ones that fail the filter -- so if the top-k are all the wrong team, you get few or zero results. PRE-FILTER restricts to the allowed documents first, then takes the top-k among those -- so you always get k allowed results if enough exist.
_meta.data_is: A FIXTURE. The scores and teams are hand-authored so the three highest-scoring documents are all the wrong team: post-filter on top-3 returns 0 allowed results, while pre-filter returns 3. Every retrieval is computed in prefilter.py.
_meta.format: k: results wanted; allowed_team: the metadata value the query is permitted; docs: [{id, score, team}].
